verdict.rationale: v0 docs confirm GitHub integration lets users push full code to their own repository (v0-docs-2, v0-docs-31, v0-docs-27), meaning the underlying source (typically a Next.js app) can be cloned and run/hosted elsewhere. However, there's no explicit 'export/download code' feature described, and platform messaging emphasizes one-click deploy to Vercel infrastructure rather than self-hosting elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit code export/download flow independent of GitHub, and independent/hands-on evidence of successfully running or hosting a v0-generated app outside Vercel.
